title: Chapter 1135
text:
"Interacted with him before? Let me see what he looks like. "

Han Xiao was curious.

Aesop took out his communicator, operated it, and brought up a 3D image of a person.

This was a pale man who looked like a Blue Star Caucasian. Han Xiao sized him up for a long time and felt that he was very unfamiliar. There was no such person in his memory.

"Strange, I've never seen this person before," Han Xiao said. "Anyway, I'll get someone to look for him on Blue Star."

Since he was able to be predicted by Aesop, this person was definitely involved in something important. He did not know if it was good or bad for him to descend on Blue Star. After all, Blue Star was his mother planet in name, so he still had to be concerned about its safety.

"You said that this was the first thing. What's the second thing?"

"I foresaw the reappearance of history." Aesop frowned, looking a little confused.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. "You mean …"

"In my foresight, many historical figures who had died long ago descended to the world again. I even saw the figure of the Primordial Ones."

Could it be about the Holy Covenant reviving Beyond Grade As? This meant that old man Aesop also vaguely foresaw this future. Then, the cause of the prophecy should be the deal between him and Oathkeeper.

"Hmm? You don't seem surprised by this prophecy. "Aesop was confused.

"I have some understanding of this matter." Han Xiao stroked his chin and asked, "By the way, do you know any information …"

He briefly asked about the Holy Covenant organization, Oathkeeper, the Sanctums, and so on, hoping that Aesop, who had traveled extensively, would know some information that ordinary people did not.

Unfortunately, Aesop shook his head, indicating that he had never heard of these things.

However, when he mentioned Oathkeeper, he seemed to have thought of something.

"The High Dimensional Psychic Projection ability that ignores distance is not common. It sounds simple, but the requirements are actually very strict. Psychics and most psychic Esper Abilities cannot do it. If it's not his own Esper Ability, then it's a bit like a legendary Primal Esper Ability Entity, Soul Flame."

As soon as he heard the words' Primal Esper Ability ', Han Xiao knew that it was reliable and quickly asked.

"Do you know anything else?"

"Soul Flame is one of the Super High Risk Esper Abilities. There have been no sightings of it for many years … Oh, you probably know this basic information, so I won't repeat it. I'll tell you something you don't know. When I was young, I seemed to have a premonition. That premonition warned me that if I did something, a person who used Soul Flame would suddenly appear and try to control me, forcing me to help him find something. So, I followed my foresight and avoided disaster, avoiding this line of fate. This guy might be the Oathkeeper you mentioned. This is my only interaction with him. "

After talking for a while, Han Xiao realized that this was all Aesop knew about Oathkeeper, so he could only give up. He made a mental note of the name 'Soul Flame' and planned to ask the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and the Holy Light Particle. They were both members of the Primal Esper Ability family, so they should know more.

Moreover, Primal Esper Ability Entities had a long lifespan. If he knew who had the last time Soul Flame fell into, he might be able to get more information about the Holy Covenant organization.

"Since you know about this, I won't emphasize it." Aesop raised a third finger and said seriously, "There's one last prophecy. I foresee that a universe-level disaster is brewing in a place we can't see."

"You're not talking about the Intelligent Plague, are you? Then your prophecy has probably expired. "

"Do I look like I'm joking with you?" Aesop said angrily. "I see wormholes that span tens of millions of miles open in the void, and fleets swarm out. A galactic war no less intense than the exploration era will break out. No one will be able to stay out of it."

Han Xiao's eyes narrowed.

It sounded like the invasion of the World Tree Civilization.

Prophecies would not appear out of nowhere. There had to be some kind of trigger or change. Now that Aesop had predicted this future, it meant that there was some progress in the World Tree Civilization's plot.

The first thing Han Xiao thought of was the wormhole coordinates back then. It was very difficult to locate a wormhole that had accidentally opened in an unexplored universe without a frame of reference. The workload was huge, and it required a lot of manpower and resources to calculate, deconstruct the coordinates, and deduce the model. Even the slightest error in the data would be magnified hundreds of millions of times in reality. It required absolute precision.

His progress was limited. Could it be that the dynasty had made some progress?

It seems like I have to find some time to ask around. Back then, when EsGod accidentally obtained the wormhole coordinates, I knew that the World Tree Civilization's storyline would definitely change … Han Xiao shook his head and felt that it was indeed the case.

At this moment, Aesop stood up, patted his waist, and said casually, "I've delivered the prophecy to you. I'll leave the details to you. I'll inform you if there are any new prophecies."

He had specially told Han Xiao these prophecies and did not reveal them to Ames. That was because it was useless for Ames to know and would only treat it as a story. Only Black Star would take action. It was much more reliable.

Han Xiao was about to send him off, but Aesop waved his hand and rejected him. However, when he reached the door, he suddenly stopped in his tracks and thought of something.

"By the way, there's something I have to tell you. While I was waiting for you, I casually helped your subordinate predict something. This lad named Harrison has quite a future. His destiny line is very thick, and it has already deviated from its original trajectory due to the disturbance."

With that, Aesop opened the door and left. Han Xiao turned to look at the confused Harrison and was not surprised.

Harrison had been poached by him, so of course, his destiny line had changed. The World Tree Civilization's war might break out earlier, and it was not certain if he would still sacrifice himself like in his previous life.

Han Xiao sorted out the three prophecies. Although they were all rather vague, Aesop had indirectly provided him with a lot of key information, and he had more clues.

The best thing to deal with now was the prophecy to find someone. Han Xiao threw the image of the target to Philip and asked him to compare it to the surveillance of the entire planet. He then gathered the people of the Black Star Corps stationed in the Blue Star stronghold and spread out to search the entire planet.

With his influence on Planet Aquamarine, even if it was a cockroach, he would be able to find it, let alone a human.

My name is Rody Anchor, and I'm 48 years old this year. I'm a citizen of Frost Forest City, Red Maple Province, Blue Star. I live in Xibro Neighborhood, Chenguang Street, Block B, Room 1511. My ID is 77054591 A62H, and I work in the Filo Corporation branch three streets away. I'm the Deputy Manager of the Operations Department.

My parents were survivors of the old era, and they died in a riot caused by the Mutation Disaster. At that time, I was still an ignorant child. The disaster caused a large-scale exodus of the city's residents, and the shops on the streets were robbed clean. Charred skeletons of abandoned cars could be seen everywhere on the streets. I lived in such a desolate city for a few weeks before I was luckily found by the rescue team of the Black Star Corps. I was then brought to the Sanctuary to live.

After that, His Excellency Black Star resolved the Mutation Disaster, and I was sent to Public Orphanage No. 87. After six years of counseling by Teacher Melissa, I finally walked out of the psychological shadow of my childhood and got rid of my social phobia, depression, and other symptoms.

After that, life seemed to have sped up. Going to school, graduating, entering society, participating in the reconstruction of Blue Star, constantly changing jobs, moving around, having one girlfriend after another, experiencing two failed marriages … Life flashed by like a white steed, and the rapid development of the times affected the life of every laborer. Like everyone else in my generation, I bravely moved forward and contributed to the new era. I worked hard, and I personally witnessed the rapid development of Blue Star after it connected with the galaxy.

However, as I grew older, my ambition for my career became weaker and weaker. Instead, I missed my parents more and more. Five years ago, I resigned from my job in a large enterprise in Black Star City and returned to my parents' hometown, Frost Forest City.

The reconstruction of my hometown had already been completed, and I bought a property in this city. I found a new job and chose to settle down here.

The new job was very leisurely, and there was not as intense a competitive environment as the capital. Life here was as simple as drinking water, and the people I saw every day were the same people. As I grew older, I liked a slow life, and I quickly adapted to and fell in love with this kind of daily peace.

Galaxy Calendar Year 731, July 16th, I still remember that it was a bright and sunny morning. I woke up very early, washed up as usual, and prepared to take out last night's leftover dinner from the fridge and heat it up for breakfast as usual.

But when I was washing up, I suddenly realized that I could not see my reflection in the mirror!

A huge panic gripped my heart, and I did not know what had happened. I curled up in the corner of the bathroom and looked around uneasily, as though some monster would jump out at any moment. I trembled like this for more than a minute before I mustered up the courage to run out of the bathroom. I did not even dare to wear my shoes as I hurriedly grabbed my keys and rushed out of the house. I pressed the elevator button like a madman.

The apartment I lived in was an apartment with a total of 33 floors and four elevators. Every time it was rush hour, the elevator would always go up to the highest floor and then slowly descend. It would stop at almost every floor. Usually, I would watch the morning news while waiting for the elevator, but now the waiting time felt like years. I was so anxious that I wanted to break open the elevator door and pull the cable inside to pull the elevator down.

The elevator finally reached the 15th floor where I was. When the elevator door opened, it was almost full of people. Occasionally, when there was an overload situation like this, I would politely greet the neighbors inside and then obediently wait for the next elevator. But now, I did not care so much. I grabbed the elevator door and shouted at them, telling them what had just happened.

However, I soon realized that no one was looking at me, and no one heard me. It was as though in their eyes, I did not exist!

Just when I was in panic and fear, the people inside found that the elevator door could not be closed. They pressed the button to close the door in puzzlement. There was even someone who wanted to hit the elevator door and it just happened to land on my arm.

What happened next made me even more frightened. This person's hand easily passed through my arm as if I was just an illusion.

Before my brain could react, my vision suddenly trembled like water ripples and I hallucinated. A woman in the elevator did not hold the communication device in her hand and it fell to the ground.

At this moment, my body suddenly exploded with intense pain. I could not control my body and fell to the ground, twitching. My vision quickly blurred and a strong sense of sleepiness rushed to my brain.

The moment before I fainted, I vaguely saw a communication device that was exactly the same as the one in the hallucination between the legs of many pairs of legs. It fell to the ground in the elevator …

In the next second, I fainted.

When I woke up again, the sky was already dark. I was still lying in front of the elevator door, and a sense of weakness ran through my body. Doudou

That feeling was as though I had not eaten for two days and had stayed up two nights at the same time.

The intense hunger seemed to have chased away my fear. I moved back home step by step and almost finished all the food in the fridge. Only then did I regain my strength. During that time, I tried to use the metal cutlery and the camera to reflect my figure, but they all failed.

After that, I forced myself to calm down and conducted many tests. I realized that I did not exist in the eyes of anyone, and I was unable to touch anyone. However, I seemed to be able to affect some substances that did not come into contact with living beings.

Thus, I tried driving, stealing, causing accidents, and so on. Most of the actions that could affect others were interrupted by sudden fainting. However, many of my attempts at stealing succeeded, and no one noticed … Fortunately, I was able to survive until now. Otherwise, I would have starved to death long ago.

The hallucinations that caused me to faint appeared frequently. I realized that I seemed to be able to foresee the future, but I was unable to activate or deactivate it. The moment I activated it, I would faint and feel weak. I guessed that this ability was exhausting my physical strength.

I thought of the Mutation Disaster in the past. A terrifying mutation must have happened to my body.

I lived in this state for two to three months. At first, I was very scared, then I felt happy for a period of time. However, after that, it turned into confusion and emptiness. I was unable to interact with people in reality, so I tried to communicate with people online.

However, I realized that no matter what form I used to leave a message, it seemed to be ignored by others. I sent messages to my friends, but I never received a reply. Even the company did not call me to ask why I did not go to work. It was as if they had all agreed that I had disappeared from the face of the earth. I did not understand why.

Thus, I wrote this diary. If anyone sees my diary, I hope that you can come and help me. My address is Frost Forest City, Red Maple Province, Morning Light Street, West Brow Neighborhood, Block B, Room 1511. I will wait for you at home.

Blue Star's first public announcement channel, post 'Help! I have disappeared! '

A day later, on Floating Dragon Island …

"There is no such person?"

Han Xiao received the search report from Philip and the many army members. He could not help but raise his brows.

"Master, hum … Not only did we not find anything in the surveillance footage, we also screened the household registration files of the Aquamarine Federation and compared the ID photos of all the citizens. There is no match, hum …"

On the other side, the army warrior who was in charge of the search also explained, "We used all kinds of life detection devices to scan the entire planet, even the wild, but we still couldn't find the target. Is this person really on Planet Aquamarine?"

Han Xiao knocked on the table and turned to look at Harrison. "What do you think?"

"Me?" Harrison pointed at himself with surprise, hesitated for a moment, and said, "Why don't we just release a missing person notice?"

"Alright."

Han Xiao nodded. He was originally unsure of the background of this person in Aesop's prophecy, so he did not want to alert the enemy. However, since he could not find the person now, there was no harm in trying to release a missing person notice. Anyway, he was here, so he was not afraid of anyone causing trouble.

He wanted to see what kind of relationship he had with this stranger.
